title: Horn activation and warning beep behavior
summary: Reviews discuss both appreciation for the running-vehicle horn warning and complaints or unclear feedback about horn activation effort and loud, prolonged beeping.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the horn honking when the driver exits while the vehicle is still running.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the horn is difficult to activate and may require a firm press in the center.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback mentions a preference for a softer, shorter beep and a report of nonstop horn blaring, but the sample is too limited to classify the overall stance more precisely.

limitations: The sample is very small and sentiment is undetermined in multiple fragments, limiting confidence in a single interpretation.
The topic includes more than one horn-related subject, including a running-vehicle warning honk, horn activation effort, and loud or prolonged beeping.
One negative example includes a fragment whose fragment-level sentiment is undetermined even though the review is assigned negative, so the evidence is somewhat coarse.
